title: In-Person Appointments Reference: Reschedules, Video Conversion, Clinic Rebooking and the Waitlist
content:
The allowances below govern changes to a booked In-Person Appointments visit, per visit type.

| Visit type | Patient reschedules allowed per appointment | Move to another clinician of the department on reschedule | Conversion to a video visit | Latest conversion request (hours before start) | Priority replacement slot after a clinic cancellation (business days) | Earlier-slot waitlist | Waitlist offer held (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nurse Visit | 3 | Yes | No | 0 | 5 | No | 0 |
| Established Patient Office Visit | 3 | Yes | Yes | 2 | 5 | Yes | 60 |
| New Patient Office Visit | 2 | Yes | Yes | 4 | 10 | Yes | 60 |
| Annual Preventive Exam | 3 | Yes | No | 0 | 10 | Yes | 120 |
| Specialist Consultation | 2 | No | Yes | 4 | 10 | Yes | 120 |
| In-Office Procedure Visit | 2 | No | No | 0 | 10 | Yes | 240 |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment | 2 | Yes | No | 0 | 5 | Yes | 240 |

### Definitions

- **Patient reschedules allowed** is the maximum number of patient-requested reschedules of one appointment.
- **Move to another clinician** records whether a reschedule may move the visit to a different clinician of the same department.
- **Conversion to a video visit** records whether the booked visit may be converted to a video visit at the patient's request, and **latest conversion request** is the latest point, in hours before the scheduled start, at which that request may be made.
- **Priority replacement slot** is the number of business days within which a clinic-cancelled visit is offered a priority replacement slot.
- **Earlier-slot waitlist** records whether the patient may join the earlier-slot waitlist for the visit type, and **waitlist offer held** is the number of minutes a waitlist slot offer is held for the patient before it passes to the next person.

### Reading the allowances

- Three visit types allow 3 patient reschedules (Nurse Visit, Established Patient Office Visit, Annual Preventive Exam); the other four allow 2.
- The Specialist Consultation and the In-Office Procedure Visit are the two visit types on which a reschedule may not move the visit to another clinician.
- Video conversion is open to the Established Patient Office Visit up to 2 hours before the start, and to the New Patient Office Visit and the Specialist Consultation up to 4 hours before.
- The Nurse Visit is the only visit type with no earlier-slot waitlist.
